scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-electron',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npm run build:preload
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run remote-config:prepare && electron-builder --dir && npm run remote-config:cleanup
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run remote-config:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis zip && npm run remote-config:emit && npm run remote-config:cleanup
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run remote-config:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis zip && npm run remote-config:emit && npm run remote-config:cleanup
scripts.release:desktop: npm run release:pack && npm run release:upload
scripts.release:runtime: npm run release:pack:runtime && npm run release:upload:runtime
scripts.release: npm run release:pack && npm run release:upload
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/account-session.test.mjs tests/account-session-integration.test.mjs tests/material-account-store.test.mjs tests/active-session-api.test.mjs tests/account-service.test.mjs tests/aliyun-gateway-key.test.mjs tests/installer-update-policy.test.mjs tests/managed-config.test.mjs tests/local-media-protocol.test.mjs tests/material-auto-reuse.test.mjs tests/material-directory.test.mjs tests/material-directory-model.test.mjs tests/material-local-store.test.mjs tests/material-cloud-service.test.mjs tests/material-drag-and-drop-model.test.mjs tests/material-file-operations.test.mjs tests/material-item-actions-model.test.mjs tests/materials-service-folder-operations.test.mjs tests/material-analysis-diagnostics.test.mjs tests/material-analysis-transfer.test.mjs tests/incremental-artifacts.test.mjs tests/resume-material-manifest.test.mjs tests/progress-template-model.test.mjs tests/release-upload-config.test.mjs tests/release-version.test.mjs tests/runtime-release-base.test.mjs tests/task-models.test.mjs tests/shot-material-picker.test.mjs tests/task-event-reducer.test.mjs tests/task-events.test.mjs tests/task-service.test.mjs tests/runtime-archive.test.mjs tests/runtime-install.test.mjs tests/runtime-paths.test.mjs
